why_added: the first run surfaced a fixture-label collision in star-plus-exempt-row (o20..o24 appear in both label sets, so git matched 5 common lines and the tool correctly reported deleted=20; the prediction of 25 for distinct text was right). While correcting that fixture, this probe was added to cover the other same-file row conflict: `only=` plus `exempt=`, which file_regions() (:384) resolves by concatenation while the prefix filter at :464 runs before the origin gate.

scenarios.axis: two contract rows matching one file: one only= (prefix) and one exempt=

contract_rows: SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	only=## Errata@NOTES.md:2	only row
SCORE.md	A-corr	NOTES.md:1	exempt=## Axes@NOTES.md:3	exempt row
fixture.c1: SCORE.md: [# score, ## Axes, 25 zed lines, ## Errata, e0..e2]; NOTES.md:1 binds both rows, NOTES.md:2 declares the Errata region append-only, NOTES.md:3 names the Axes head as re-derived
fixture.c2: the 25 ## Axes lines rewritten in place with distinct text (zed* -> znew*)

intended.reason: the only row declares that only ## Errata lines are append-only and the exempt row declares ## Axes re-derived, so both rows agree that an ## Axes rewrite is ungraded

scenarios.why: file_regions() returns prefixes=['## Errata'] and titles={'## Axes'}; in the deleted-line loop the prefix filter (:464) `continue`s every line whose parent section does not start with '## Errata' before the origin gate (:475) is reached, so all 25 lines are ungraded by absence rather than by exemption
